info.title: Calculate Working Day Universal API
info.description: Calculate valid working days, next working days, month boundaries, and working-day offsets using Mightora's free Calculate Working Day API.

get.description: Retrieves the next Monday-to-Friday working day.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Input date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

schema.description: Input date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

input_date.description: Input date returned by the API.

next_working_day.description: Next working day after the input date.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.summary: Combination Of All Calculate Working Day Endpoints
get.description: Retrieves combined results from all working-day calculations.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Input date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

schema.description: Input date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: working_days
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of working day numbers where Monday is 1.

schema.description: Comma-separated list of working day numbers where Monday is 1.

parameters.name: x_working_days
parameters.description: Number of working days to add.

schema.description: Number of working days to add.

parameters.name: non_working_days
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated dates in YYYY-MM-DD format to treat as non-working days.

schema.description: Optional comma-separated dates in YYYY-MM-DD format to treat as non-working days.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Optional country value for bank holiday filtering.

schema.description: Optional country value for bank holiday filtering.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

first_working_day_of_month.description: First working day in the input date's month.

input_date.description: Input date returned by the API.

is_input_date_a_working_day.description: Whether the input date is a working day.

last_working_day_of_month.description: Last working day in the input date's month.

next_working_day.description: Next working day after the input date.

non_working_days.description: Non-working dates used in the calculation.

working_day_in_x_days.description: Working day found after adding the requested number of working days.

working_days.description: Working day numbers used in the calculation.

working_days_in_words.description: Working day names used in the calculation.

x_days.description: Number of working days added to the input date.
